column1: # French (fr) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# French video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands use the infinitive ("Enregistrer
# sous…"), messages address the user as "vous", and labels use French sentence case. Product,
# format and technology names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, LUFS, EDL, AAF…) keep their
# spelling. French spacing: a space before ":", ";", "?" and "!". This catalog has the same entries
# as `es.tsv`; strings added later show in English until they
# are translated. A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = clip, track = piste, sequence = séquence, timeline = timeline, bin = chutier,
# playhead = tête de lecture, In/Out = point d'entrée / de sortie, marker = marqueur, keyframe =
# image clé, frame hold = image figée, edit point = point de montage, panel = panneau, workspace =
# espace de travail, render = rendu, preset = préréglage, captions = sous-titres, ripple = avec
# décalage, overwrite = écraser, scopes = oscilloscopes, preferences =
# Préférences, settings = paramètres.
